description: Reduced effect radius from 6 tiles to 5 tiles. Range Removed totem damage. Damage Removed the ability to benefit from Life Aura from the Life Gem or Apprentice Warden.
requiredText:

        守护者学徒和生命宝石装备无法再给图腾施加加血效果了。

description: Added the Dragon Duke to the game, but it is not immediately available yet. The community has to free it by collecting Dark Elixir and opening doors for rewards. Announced the Unleash the Duke event.
requiredText:
飞龙公爵已经添加到游戏中，但需要通过活动获取。
        当时仍未开放使用；社区通过收集暗黑重油、开门领取奖励的活动释放飞龙公爵。 来源

description: The Dragon Duke has been freed from his imprisonment, along with new event challenges that involves him.
requiredText:
飞龙公爵正式推出，15 本可解锁。
